tickets.title: Authority and source inventory
tickets.scope: Map every proposed contract to its authoritative existing service, phase readiness, exact permission and privacy purpose; inventory existing tasks/automations so no duplicate owner is introduced.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Approved source-binding matrix, zero undocumented protected action, active change alignment.

tickets.title: Pure dialect and compiler
tickets.scope: Implement strict schema, typed AST normalization, graph IR and digest, predicate evaluator, branch/join rules, reference dominance and classification propagation.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Property tests and negative fixtures prove deterministic compile and rejection behavior.

tickets.title: Tenant-safe process storage
tickets.scope: Design additive migrations using existing owners; implement composite tenant references, immutable publications, run revisions, occurrences, waits, intent links and constrained application grants.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Migration forward/rollback proof, DB race tests, no broad browser writes.

tickets.title: Runtime automation authority
tickets.scope: Bind current source capabilities to tenant automation grants; separate publisher, initiator, delegate and human approver; enforce revocation at each action.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Cross-role/tenant negative tests and grant departure/revocation tests pass.

tickets.title: Event intake and enrollment
tickets.scope: Use source outbox and durable receipts; implement prospective binding generation, subject-scoped enrollment, historical-dark handling and accepted event dedupe.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Out-of-order commit, duplicate, import, and missing wake tests pass.

tickets.title: Evaluator and durable advance
tickets.scope: Implement pure next-work plans, short CAS transactions, source revision verification, selected-branch state, bounded continuations and source-result wakes.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Concurrent joins advance once and completed history remains immutable.

tickets.title: Operation intents and provider ambiguity
tickets.scope: Bind permanent domain effect identities to existing claims/outbox; implement fencing, exact prepared payload reference, safe retry and unknown-result reconciliation.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Ambiguous send and expired lease tests cannot produce blind duplicate effects.

tickets.title: Waits, reminders and calendars
tickets.scope: Implement registration/recheck handshake, source event consumers, indexed due reconciliation, pinned calendars, DST rules, pause clocks and catch-up policy.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Both completion orderings and lost-wake recovery work; no timeout approvals.

tickets.title: Shared task and role adapter
tickets.scope: Adapt shared tasks, typed outcomes, qualified roles/fallbacks, source-controlled reassignment, conflict-of-interest checks and scoped My Work queries.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Assignment does not grant permission; task result cannot invent source approval.

tickets.title: Communication intent adapter
tickets.scope: Request source-governed publications/audiences, coordinate shared purposes, enforce suppression at send, preserve inbound correlation and safe webhook interpretation.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: No duplicate donor purpose, no raw Resend graph call, no unsafe source-state notice.

tickets.title: Forms, files and evidence
tickets.scope: Implement/adopt versioned forms, allowed mappings, save/resume/submissions, private evidence lifecycle, required-category qualification and currentness adapters.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Double submit safe; quarantined/obsolete evidence cannot satisfy requirements.

tickets.title: External participant sessions
tickets.scope: Reuse protected-action exchange for scoped reference tasks; implement expiry/revocation, scanner-safe interaction and source-authorized submissions.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: No scanner side effects or access to another applicant; restricted scopes require stronger assurance.

tickets.title: No-side-effect simulation
tickets.scope: Use the real evaluator with synthetic source adapters, virtual clock, explicit safe fixtures and permission-projection previews.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: No transport/credential access; production semantics and simulation outcomes align for fixture set.

tickets.title: Publication and dependency governance
tickets.scope: Implement immutable preflights/publications, independent review where required, activation boundary, reverse dependency index and incompatible-reference blocking.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Stale/revoked preflights fail; old runs remain pinned.

tickets.title: Run amendment and migration
tickets.scope: Implement impact diff, source-approved evidence reuse, assignment/deadline edits, structural revisions, cancellation epochs and controlled version migrations.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Per-applicant extra interview changes only that case; no history erase or repeated sends.

tickets.title: Guided editor and canvas/outline
tickets.scope: Build exact base-maia UI, contextual catalog, sentence editor and constrained React Flow AST operations, inspectors, autosave/revision conflict UI and full outline alternative.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Keyboard task succeeds, advanced/simple conversion is lossless, 250-node target measured.

tickets.title: Run operations and participant journeys
tickets.scope: Build staff run overlay and activity, shared My Work, applicant My Journey, safe source milestones, error recovery and low-bandwidth submission UX.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: No staff depth leaks; mobile poor-network submission is safe.

tickets.title: Donation and development packs
tickets.scope: Implement source-certified contribution/recognition/recurring predicates, donor and missionary purpose coordination, development hooks and default-off starters.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: All DON recipe tests and related MPD tests pass through real source services.

tickets.title: Mobilization and onboarding pack
tickets.scope: Implement inquiry, references/interviews/screening, source decisions, reusable onboarding, training/documents, readiness, withdrawal and amendment blueprints.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: MOB recipe tests pass including required references, conditional acceptance and receiving handoff.

tickets.title: Support Hub rule adoption
tickets.scope: Migrate/adopt the existing inert rule vocabulary into Studio; keep contextual settings as views; preserve source clocks, quarantine, threads and collision safety.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: GEN support recipes pass; exactly one rules execution owner per active rule.

tickets.title: Content, events and documents packs
tickets.scope: Bind exact-revision approvals, source schedules/capacity/payment classification, translations, renewal and participant training to common primitives.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: COM and relevant GEN tests pass; publication and waitlist source outcomes remain truthful.

tickets.title: Protected finance coordination
tickets.scope: Expose approved coordination-only hooks and native settings; disallow prototype correction/replay shortcuts and arbitrary approval graphs.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: All FIN tests and source separation-of-duties certification pass.

tickets.title: Sealed care coordination
tickets.scope: Implement invisible-by-default sealed scope, source-qualified roles, safe notifications, private audit and emergency/records handoffs without authority duplication.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: CARE tests plus zero-existence-leak and provider handling qualification pass.

tickets.title: Portability, upgrades and rollout
tickets.scope: Implement inert template export/import with rebinding, versioned action compatibility, shadow migration of legacy rules, bounded canary enablement and rollback.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: No imported code/tenant IDs; source effect identities survive cutover; no dual-running engines.

tickets.title: Observability, load and recovery
tickets.scope: Implement safe metrics, independent outage heartbeat, due-work and outcome recovery, fair admission, cost instrumentation, restore suppression and operator runbooks.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Fault drills and documented performance/load targets pass with actual provider configuration.

tickets.title: Acceptance, pilot and release evidence
tickets.scope: Execute all required suites, source adapter checks, accessibility tests and representative-tenant pilot; document unresolved gates honestly; use staged source-ready rollout.
tickets.acceptanceEvidence: Repository validation and review accepted; no critical findings; release/rollback evidence attached.
